Part of #25921 (batch 11, claim 6696974190 with amendments 6697003965 naming the branch, 6697084388 naming the first batch and amendment 3 renaming it to this one; the card's other open items stay on it)

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：从 `@object-ui/types` 的 `ui-action.ts` 删除 3 个没人读的类型：`ActionExecutor`，以及 "Batch Operations" 一组的 `BatchOperationConfig`、`BatchOperationSummary`。
- 为什么改：#25921 清理零消费者公开面；这 3 个名字在仓内与 hotcrm 都没有任何引用，动作实际由 `@object-ui/core` 的 `ActionRunner` 执行，留着会被当成 UI 协议包的公开承诺。
- 风险与回滚：纯类型删除，构建出的 JavaScript 不变；旁边的 "Transaction Support" 一组（core 的 `TransactionManager` 在用）原样保留。对外部 npm 使用者是破坏性变更，带一个 `!` patch changeset（BREAKING、FROM/TO、ADR-0087 `runtime-export-retired` 3 个）。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/types/src/ui-action.ts`（删掉的三个声明与新注释）、`.changeset/25921-types-action-executor-batch-ops.md`（迁移说明）、`ui/packages/types/src/index.ts`（入口列表与注释）。
- 两分钟验证：`git grep -lw -e ActionExecutor -e BatchOperationConfig -e BatchOperationSummary -- ui packages` 预期只命中 `ui/packages/types` 里的退役注释、本 changeset 与 CHANGELOG；`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/types/` 预期全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`@object-ui/types` (its `.` entry) loses 3 types of `src/ui-action.ts`. They are deleted from the module, not only from the entry:

`ActionExecutor`, `BatchOperationConfig`, `BatchOperationSummary`.

- `src/ui-action.ts`: the `ActionExecutor` function type and the "Batch Operations (Q2 2026 - Spec v2.0.1 Enhancement)" block go; a note at the end of the file, beside the existing undo/redo note, names them and points at `@object-ui/core`'s `ActionRunner` / `ActionRunnerHandler`. The "Transaction Support" block right after them stays: `TransactionConfig` and `TransactionResult` are imported by core's `TransactionManager.ts`.
- `src/index.ts`: the three names leave the `./ui-action.js` type list; a two-line comment names them.
- `.changeset/25921-types-action-executor-batch-ops.md`: one `!` patch changeset, BREAKING, FROM/TO per name (no replacement in this package; actions run through `ActionRunner`), and the ADR-0087 `runtime-export-retired` marker naming all 3.

`ui-action.ts` is reached only through the `.` entry; no subpath entry of the package exports it.

**Why this batch and not the first one named.** Amendment 6697084388 first named the seven `Spec`-prefixed `@objectstack/spec/ui` type aliases of the entry (`SpecFormView` and six more), also dead. That edit was made (fa034725) and reverted in this branch (ae6a942a), because `check-adr-0087-registration` cannot verify predicate 2 for them: they are `export type { X as SpecX } from '@objectstack/spec/ui'`, a subpath of another workspace package, which the gate's export reader does not follow ("the declaration of `SpecFormView` cannot be located at the merge base"). The seat swapped the batch (amendment 3); the seven stay on the card, waiting on a predicate-2 ruling for that shape. The branch diff against `main` carries only this batch.

## Tests

- No in-package test reads any of the 3 names, so no test changes.
- No ablation: a deletion of types with no tested behaviour behind it. The reverse probe below is the proof that the built `.d.ts` is the one read.

- Positive control, same module: `TransactionConfig` (core `TransactionManager.ts`).

## Acceptance notes

- The seven `Spec`-prefixed spec/ui aliases (`SpecDashboardHeader`, `SpecDashboardHeaderAction`, `SpecFormView`, `SpecListColumn`, `SpecPageComponent`, `SpecPageRegion`, `SpecPageVariable`) stay on #25921: zero readers, but their retirement needs a predicate-2 ruling for re-export aliases of a workspace subpath. No gate card is filed now (seat's call).
- Still open on #25921 after this batch: `clearSharedDiscoveryCache` and the other barrel batches; in `@object-ui/types` the census lists `data-protocol.ts` (3 real names in two blocks), `designer.ts` (Unified View with the objectui#12063 tombstone pin, Dashboard with a zod twin) and scattered singles. `types/src/ai.ts` keeps its `never` tombstones until the sunset rule of #25912; not touched here.
